notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no WAF/challenge (tier 1 only). No genuine Clearance/Outlet PLP exists on this site. What was checked: (1) main/category navigation - fetched ~17 category PLPs (lamps-lightings, wall-decor, mirrors, clocks, showpieces, showpieces-vases, glassware, mugs-and-cups, mugs-cups-drinkware, coffee-mugs, dinner-sets, pots-planters, religious-spiritual-items, trays-platters, wall-art-paintings, bowls, serveware) and inspected every 'plp-sub-nav' tile on each - tile labels found were things like 'Best Seller', 'New Arrivals'/'What's New', 'Fast Delivery', and various material/type sub-categories; NOT ONE category page anywhere showed a 'Clearance' or 'Outlet' tile. (2) Both collections sitemaps (sitemap_collections_1.xml + _2.xml, 3226 URLs total) grepped for clearance/outlet/sale/discount/offer - found 5 sale-worded collections, all examined and excluded: 'clearance-sale' slug actually resolves to a page titled 'Kaleen Rugs, Carpets & Soft Layers Guide' with h1='Kaleen' and breadcrumb='Kaleen' - it is a rebranded/renamed Kaleen-brand landing page that kept an old 'clearance-sale' URL handle; it carries zero clearance/markdown signal on-page, so it is excluded per the Clearance-vs-brand-page distinction. 'anti-skid-bath-mats-on-sale' has 0 products ('No products in this collection yet'). 'black-friday-sale' (h1 'Black Friday Sale Up To 75% OFF', 71181 products) and 'independence-day-sale' (h1 'Made in India Sale - UpTo 75% OFF', 20354 products) are textbook temporary seasonal percent-off campaigns - excluded per brief's explicit Black-Friday/seasonal-sale exclusion. 'wall-decor-on-sale' (h1 'HRS Sale - Wall Decor', 7190 products) is a named temporary promotional campaign, not an outlet/permanent-markdown listing - excluded. (3) sitemap_pages_1.xml - only 7 static pages exist (contact, partner-with-vaaree, gifting-and-bulk-orders, affiliate-partnership, vaaree-home-index-2025, refund-policy, vibe-membership-terms-conditions), none clearance/outlet-related. (4) Site's own search for 'clearance' (266 products found) and 'outlet' (16 products found) returns generic keyword matches on a /search results page, not a merchandising PLP - per brief, search-results pages are explicitly excluded as a PLP type regardless of result count, so these are supporting evidence of absence only, not a clearance listing. (5) Direct slug probing: /collections/clearance, /collections/outlet, /collections/final-sale, /collections/offers, /collections/discounts, /collections/deals all 404. Conclusion: this site runs name-your-own-campaign seasonal sales (Black Friday, Independence Day) but has no clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance/end-of-line merchandising concept anywhere in its taxonomy.
